own_solution.law: Born rule, psi_n = sqrt(2/L) sin(n pi x/L): P = w/L - [sin(2 n pi (x1+w)/L) - sin(2 n pi x1/L)]/(2 n pi)
assumptions: ideal infinite square well of width 3 nm

notes: Checked R answers: q = 0.16 -> 1.06/3 - (sin(0.21333 pi) - sin(0.8 pi))/(4 pi) = 0.353333 - 0.002655 = 0.350678; q = 0.24 -> 0.38 - 0.020415 = 0.359585; q = 0.56 -> 0.486667 - (0.714473 - 0.587785)/(4 pi) = 0.476585. Base 0.3 + 0.587785/(4 pi) = 0.3467745, so the certified 0.346774 and my pass-1 0.346775 agree within rounding at the last digit. Moving the right edge right by q widens the slice by q (slice stays inside the well for all values, max edge 2.06 nm < 3 nm). Minimal pairs T1E15/T3E63 (metal strip vs probe slice) and TE83E/T6A0A (earlier measurement only vs before this measurement) keep 0.24 nm and differ only in attachment; T0018 and TE382 are declared numeral-free controls. The authors' internal quantity label 'a further strip' is a loose name for the edge shift but does not appear in the item text and does not affect any claim.
